lines.text: [sighs] A social app for sharing photos of your lunch. [pause] Really.
lines.sourceNote: Public interviews on focus and taste

lines.text: [interrupting] Wait, wait. After all this time, this is what you came up with? What is the limiting factor here, the lunch?
lines.sourceNote: Public talks on first principles reasoning

lines.text: [softly] Who are the first one hundred users? [pause] Your roommates?
[annoyed] What have you done to the world? There are forty seven buttons in this demo.
lines.sourceNote: Public interviews on focus and taste

lines.text: [laughs awkwardly] Okay. I am out. [pause] Someone call me when physics gets involved.
lines.sourceNote: Public talks on first principles reasoning

verdict.summary: The council has seen better ideas in a lunch queue.
verdict.roast: This idea is not a product, it is a screenshot of a sandwich. Go home, and think about what you have done.
